ns2:section.sectionText: Case Histories in Infrastructure Engineering This course is intended to provide detail background of infrastructure engineering challenges, problems, and failures such that the students must uncover or discover the solutions or mechanisms of failure through an interactive case history discussion. The course will give students the opportunity and skills to ask the right questions, collect and analyze data, synthesize the results, and communicate the findings both written and verbally. Pre-reqs are CEE 300, CEE 310, and CEE 320.
